cc:Work.dc:description: Carol joins the A1 account-and-mailbox checks with two additional A2 checks | Bob: Encrypted own identity; Naming salt, wrapped; Opening of T, wrapped | Mallory: Accepted identity root; Spent marker + proofs; No secret leaf or path | Carol: My account ↔ my mailbox; Bob is a live member; T pins the actual issuer | A2 FOLDED DEPOSIT GATE | Checks membership of the decrypted issuer and opens T with Carol's own key. | Being a certified identity is one claim; being this note's actual issuer is another.
